headings.style: Elegant, academic, high-contrast. Use tracking-tight for larger sizes.

mono.style: Used for the Hidden Development Panel and structural labels.

typography.instruction: Avoid 'Inter'. Do not use default bolding for all headings; consider font-medium or font-semibold with Serif.

colors.strategy: Warm, creamy off-white background with dark charcoal/ink text. Accent color is a rich terracotta/rust to evoke academic elegance. The hidden panel uses a stark dark 'terminal' theme for extreme contrast.

layouts.general: Generous spacing. p-8 to p-16 for main containers. Bento grid principles for split views.
layouts.Teacher_Setup: Split screen. Left col-span-5 with an elegant image overlay and large serif greeting. Right col-span-7 with a clean, airy form.
layouts.Student_Workspace: Asymmetrical split. col-span-8 for the main writing area (distraction-free, centered column of text max-w-2xl within the pane). col-span-4 for the AI conversation thread (sticky, scrollable).
layouts.Hidden_Panel: Collapsible sidebar or bottom drawer. Technical grid borders, dense data presentation (col-span-1 summary widgets).

component_guidelines.buttons: Sharp rectangular or very slight radius (rounded-sm). Rich terracotta background, white text. Elegant hover state: slight translate-y-px and darker bg.
component_guidelines.inputs: Editorial style: pure white background, subtle stone-200 border, focus:ring-1 focus:ring-stone-900 focus:border-stone-900. Large padding (p-4).
component_guidelines.cards: For AI invitations: flat, bg-white or bg-stone-50, 1px border-stone-200, no drop-shadow, just crisp edges.
component_guidelines.hidden_panel_widgets: Use terminal-like retro-futurism. bg-stone-900, 1px border-stone-800, monospace fonts, amber or green accents for data.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain texture on the main background to feel like paper (opacity 2-3%).
visual_enhancers.borders: Exposed structural grid lines (1px solid stone-200) between panes.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid in the academic workspace. Use solid colors. NEVER use completely transparent backgrounds over images or other content.

screens.name: Teacher Setup
screens.layout: Grid split layout. Clean editorial form on right. Vintage academic image or minimal typographic hero on left.

screens.name: Student Workspace
screens.layout: Left pane (col-span-8) acts as the 'Canvas'. Right pane (col-span-4) acts as the 'Scaffold'. No page transitions.

screens.name: Hidden Development Panel
screens.layout: Dark mode collapsible panel. Densely packed technical grid using mono font.

teacher_setup_bg.description: Vintage typewriter on a shelf with books
teacher_setup_bg.placement: Left side of the Teacher Setup screen.

motion.interactions: Smooth opacity and transform transitions. Transition specific properties, DO NOT use 'transition: all'.
motion.ai_messages: Subtle fade-in and slide-up for new AI developmental invitations.
motion.hidden_panel: Crisp slide-in from right or bottom with a 0.3s ease-in-out.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA (4.5:1). Dark charcoal on cream background ensures excellent readability.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings on inputs and textareas (ring-stone-900).
accessibility.testing: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: Setup Google Fonts: 'Cormorant Garamond' (serif), 'IBM Plex Sans' (sans), 'IBM Plex Mono' (mono) in index.html or global css.
Ensure the Hidden Panel is strictly hidden until toggled (e.g., via a small fixed button in corner or keyboard shortcut).
Do not add any features not requested (no grading, no analytics, no auth).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add '.App { text-align: center; }' in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, custom selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js (or frontend folder equivalent)
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
